conviction_note: The findings sum to +3.1: Q1 operating profit (227m yen) was already 69% of a full-year plan of 329m, the company has under-guided hard (FY26 plan 171m, actual 501m), and its 39% customer 泉州電業 raised its forecast on semiconductor-equipment demand in May-Jul. Against that, the stock ran up 17% in 20 days (+7.3% on 10-14 on heavy volume), retail sentiment is euphoric, and the company skipped a Q2 revision last year with H1 already above the full-year plan. So the scaled number is smaller (+1.98 = (2x61/100-1) x 9.0). abs_move is 9.0 because this name moved 14.6%, 17.5%, 9.7% and -22.4% on its last four prints, against a proxy of 5.1.
bar: Company full-year plan OP 329m yen / ordinary 361m (2027年2月期 第1四半期決算短信, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260715593902.pdf). There is no H1 plan. print_vs_bar = estimated H1 OP of about 420m against that full-year plan. The market's own bar (会社四季報's autumn forecast) is reported 'well above the plan' only on a Yahoo board post (snippet_only, https://finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/5817.T/bbs, 2026-10-14 11:02), so the street bar is unsourced and the findings that depend on it are capped.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed shorts are 0.9% of shares (1 seller), up 0.1pt from 0.8% as of 2026-10-14 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, via the baseline): small and slightly building. margin_ratio is null. kabutan marks the name as 制度信用 buy-only, so no margin short side exists to squeeze (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=5817, 2026-10-15). There is no option skew in Japan. The Yahoo board's 1-week sentiment reads 100% 強く買いたい across about 44.5k cumulative posts, so retail is crowded long. On 10-15 the stock opened -7% with the Nikkei -3.8% and cable peers 5803/5805/5801 down 9-10% (Yahoo chart), so the sealed 1208 spot already gave back about half of the 10-14 spike.

findings.finding: H1 operating profit will almost certainly exceed the full-year plan. Q1 OP was 227m against a 329m plan (69.0%), so Q2 standalone (Jun-Aug) needs only 102m against 177m in Q2 last year. That sets up a kabutan-style 'H1 already above the full-year plan' headline at 14:00.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 FY26 (2025-10-15 14:00): H1 OP 244m against a full-year plan of 171m, no revision, and the stock rose +14.6% on the day (446 to 511, Yahoo chart). Q1 FY27 (2026-07-15 14:00): 69% progress drew a limit-up, 855 to 1005 on the day and 1051 the next close, then faded to about 890 within two weeks.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q2 number itself is not public: there are no 月次. The Q1 progress rate is public and partly priced: the stock is 1208 against 855 before Q1 and has run up 17% in 20 days. If an H1 above the plan were fully priced, the stock would not have sold off 7% this morning and the board would not be arguing about whether it is 織り込み済み. Sized down for the run-up.
findings.independence: Last year's Q2 短信 shows the same seasonality, with H1 OP 244m against Q1 67m (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251015/140120251014573315.pdf). kabutan's Q1 article puts Q1 ordinary-profit progress at 64.3% against a 5-year average of 36.0% (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=5817&b=k202607150009).

findings.finding: The company under-guides by a wide margin: the FY26 OP plan of 171m was revised to 308m at Q3 and came in at 501m, and the FY27 plan of 329m (-34%) sits below FY26's actual. A full-year upward revision at this print would therefore likely be large. The company skipped a Q2 revision last year, though, so the revision itself is roughly a coin flip.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-01-14 Q3 with an upward revision (OP +80%): +9.7% (baseline). 2026-04-14 FY result with a -34% new-year guide: -22.4%. 2025-10-15, revision skipped although H1 was above plan: still +14.6%.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether the company revises is decided today, and its record cuts both ways: it revised at Q3 and not at Q2. The board explicitly fears '去年同様上方修正見送り' (https://finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/5817.T/bbs, 2026-10-14). A revision fully priced would show the stock at a P/E near 12-15x on a ~90 yen EPS. It sits at 27x the plan's 44 yen EPS, i.e. pricing a beat but not a large raise.
findings.independence: The 2026-04-14 variance notice shows actual OP 501m against the revised 308m, so the company beat even its own raised plan by 63% (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260414/140120260414503459.pdf). A June 2026 president change (from 植村剛嗣, who died, to 植村瑠美) is a weak hint the policy could change (https://kabutan.jp/disclosures/pdf/20260608/140120260608564867/).

findings.finding: The largest customer, 泉州電業 (39.1% of JMACS sales), reported May-Jul 2026 9M sales +19.9% and OP +40.9%. It raised its FY OP forecast 12.1% and its dividend on recovering semiconductor-equipment and machine-tool demand, with copper averaging +44.7% YoY. Two of JMACS's three Q2 months overlap that period.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance measured on this name. JMACS's Q1 text names the semiconductor industry as its main driver.
findings.why_not_priced: It was public on 2026-09-04 and JMACS has risen about 20% since, so it is mostly priced. It counts only as corroboration that Q2 demand did not roll over, through a distributor that also notes construction/電販 volumes falling. That is why it is sized small.
findings.independence: 泉州電業 Q3 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260904/140120260904531656.pdf) is the same company and counts once. Copper futures (HG=F) rose from 6.19 in June to 6.59 in August (Yahoo chart): a broad series, which supports pass-through sales.

findings.finding: A crowded retail long sits into the print. On 10-14 the stock rose +7.3% on 237,900 shares, the highest volume since July. The 20-day run-up is +16.8%, Yahoo-board sentiment is 100% 強く買いたい, and the name is 制度信用 buy-only, so leveraged longs have no short side to squeeze against. The post-Q1 spike faded within days.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Post-Q1 2026-07: limit-up, then a high of 1152 on 07-16, then 886 by 07-28. The window ends at the 10-16 close, so most of that fade lay outside it.
findings.why_not_priced: This is positioning rather than information, so it is partly priced by definition. Sized small because the sealed 1208 spot already sits 7% below the 10-14 close after a market-wide selloff, i.e. half the run-in has unwound before the window opens.
findings.independence: Yahoo daily chart volumes and closes (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/5817.T?range=6mo&interval=1d). kabutan's buy-only margin flag (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=5817).

findings.finding: Input-cost risk: the company's own Q1 text flags soaring prices for oil-derived inputs and material-supply concern from the Hormuz closure. Its resin and compound sheathing inputs could compress Q2 margin from Q1's 13.8%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured instance. FY26's Q4 material-supply concern did not materialise and margins beat (2026-04-14 variance notice).
findings.why_not_priced: The Q2 margin is unseen. The risk is named in a primary document, but the size is inference from macro (PVC price hikes in spring 2026), so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Background on industry resin price rises: https://toyokeizai.net/articles/-/939543 (macro, not company-level). The Q1 raw-material inventory build of +175m yen (same 短信) may be pre-buying that cushions costs, which cuts the other way.

rejected_candidates.detail: Already in the sealed 1208 spot and folded into the positioning finding's why_not_priced; tomorrow's market direction is not company information

baseline_tension: The findings lean positive while the run-up (+16.8% 20d) and priced_lean (-0.50) lean against. The strongest positive the release could carry is a large full-year raise, which I looked for (no pre-filed revision). The sealed spot already sits 7% below the 10-14 close after a market selloff, which shrinks the run-up objection. Negatives cut against a crowded, buy-only retail long, so the risk is a 'no revision, sell the news' print.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a series the market already has goes toward 50), applied symmetrically: the Q1 progress rate is computable from the last 短信, so the H1 finding was trimmed from +3.0 to +2.5 and p_up from 62 to 61.

Open question 4 (a run-in was sized as a short signal and the stock rose 8.15%, one case): the positioning finding was trimmed from -1.5 to -1.0, also because the sealed spot already unwound half the run-in.
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): not triggered; the set leans positive. The strongest negative (a skipped revision) is written into baseline_tension.
Net: the sum is unchanged at +3.1 by coincidence of the two trims; the scaled number moved from +2.16 to +1.98.
